node.title: H3 product and quotient fibers form a paired PGL2 intersection
node.statement: For t!=0,1, put I_inv(t)=#{x in H:1+t/(x-1) in H} and I_aff(t)=#{z in H:1+t(z-1) in H}. Then P(t)=I_inv(t), R(t)=I_aff(t)-1, and with A_t=(1-t+tZ)^n-1, C_n=Z^n-(Z-1)^n, D_n=Z^n-1 the score is exactly deg gcd(A_t,C_n)+2deg gcd(A_t,D_n). The global score cap 39 closes M35. The exact pointwise C36' target is deg gcd(A_t,C_n)>=19 => deg gcd(A_t,D_n)<=18. Rich-locus score at most 56 is a stronger sufficient condition, sharp among constant-score caps at the boundary profile. The identities and implication compilers are proved; the rectangle and score bounds remain open.
